subject: LINAGE-COUNTER
notes: kb/Work PB578 LANDED. GR2 is a pointer: "The semantics of the LINAGE-COUNTER identifier is described in 13.18.34, LINAGE clause, General rule 7." (cite.py --check 8.4.3.14.4 -> OK 2)). Every part of the rule it points to is now CONFORMS on GR-13.18.34.4-7: GR7 a) a separate counter per LINAGE file, b) read-only and qualification, c) 1 the ADVANCING PAGE reset AND its implicit increment (PB578: ADVANCING PAGE is a page overflow, EC-I-O-EOP-OVERFLOW), c) 2 ADVANCING n, c) 3 plain WRITE + 1, c) 4 reset to one on the next logical page, d) one at OPEN OUTPUT. The witnesses below are GR7's, which is what a cross-reference rule's semantics are witnessed by.
